svg.aria-label: register() latency percentiles per deduper mode; rows are stream counts, columns are message rates
svg.text: register() latency by percentile, 2 and 4 redundant streams
ns per call (log scale); Poisson bursts shared across streams, per-stream jitter; lower is better
